claim_text: Limited sun exposure may reduce cutaneous vitamin D synthesis but does not by itself diagnose deficiency or establish an individualized supplement dose; diet, life stage, season and health factors also matter.
health_goal_or_outcome: Prevent unsupported or duplicate supplementation and support context-specific assessment.
ingredient_form_or_preparation: Dietary and supplemental sources; verify product label and composition.
evidence_summary: NIH ODS Vitamin D Health Professional Fact Sheet describes dietary sources, status assessment and multiple risk factors.
limitations: Questionnaire-reported sun exposure alone is insufficient for diagnosis or dosing.
Exact source passages and underlying evidence require full appraisal before approval.
